subject.title: Surface Codex final answer candidates in activity

question: Should final-answer candidate lifecycle be accepted as a narrow Control UI Activity surface after porting, or folded into the broader native Codex progress UX tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80039?
rationale: The implementation is useful but product-surface scope remains broader than a mechanical rebase, and current main's UI refactor means the branch needs a deliberate port before review can resume.

options.title: Port and land the narrow slice
options.body: Ask the contributor to port the answer-candidate Activity handling to the current UI modules, refresh proof, and keep the broader progress issue open for remaining plan/item/reasoning UX.

options.title: Fold into the broader progress work
options.body: Close or pause this branch and require the final-answer candidate behavior to be implemented inside the canonical native Codex progress UI effort.

options.title: Defer the Activity surface
options.body: Keep current main behavior and revisit answer-candidate visibility only after maintainers settle the native Codex progress privacy and UX contract.

recommendation.title: Port and land the narrow slice
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to port the answer-candidate Activity handling to the current UI modules, refresh proof, and keep the broader progress issue open for remaining plan/item/reasoning UX.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main UI refactor and Codex app-server projector history point to steipete as the best available owner for the port/product-surface decision.
